text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Phew! We're making great progress, aren't 
we? 
At this pace, we'll make it in plenty of 
time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's still dark, so we should have 
plenty of time until sunri—kyaah...!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
It's been quite a while since the start... 
Has the lantern at the 6th station still 
not been lit?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Did their pace slow down a bit, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?! That's not it at all! 
I'm sure they just skipped it because it's 
a pain, just like Grass said earlier!

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
On that back mountain, when conditions 
like temperature and humidity align, 
severe "oroshi"—strong gusts blowing down 
the mountain—can occur.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: Where did that come from all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, the success of the 
Umamiko Pilgrimage has been heavily 
dictated by these down-valley winds. 
We cannot rule out the possibility that 
the strong winds have caused trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Be quiiieeet! Those two won't lose to a 
little wind!

text_block_list.name: Men
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The flame...! What do we do? With it pitch 
black like this, we can't see our 
footing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Dia-chan, be careful. 
We have no choice but to walk up slowly so 
we don't trip.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But if we do that, we won't make it in 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I came to watch after hearing it was 
revived after so long, but... 
It's not looking too good, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: .........Spe-chan, Sweep-chan, over here.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There is something we can do too. 
Come, follow me. Quickly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. It's because I couldn't 
protect the flame...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, it couldn't be helped with wind like 
that. 
It's okay! We just have to keep climbing 
without giving up...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait...? What's that? The shrine grounds 
are glowing?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, let us light even more 
lanterns.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If anyone doesn't have a lantern yet, 
please come this way~! 
Ehehe, if we all hold them up together, 
I'm sure they'll see them from the 
mountain!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
Waah, look, look at those girls in 
furisode! How gorgeous...! 
They're lanterns of encouragement. I want 
to pray along with those lights too!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Me too...! At this distance, the Kita-Sato 
duo should be able to see them, right? 
Cheering is all I can do, but I want my 
feelings to reach them...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, Twinkle☆ Shine even brighter~! 
And and, please let those two definitely 
make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, what a beautiful light. 
It is far too early to give up... Go for 
it! Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, Satono-chan. You two have 
overcome so much. 
I believe in you, and I know you can do 
this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaah...! Incredible... Everyone is...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: For our sake...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We have to answer everyone's wishes... 
There has to be, there must be a way...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what should we do? 
If only we had light, we could pick up our 
pace and run...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! 
I just had a great idea! We just have to 
"light it again"...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... "We split up, and I go back down 
to the bonfire at the 4th station to 
relight the lantern"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's a brilliant plan. From what I've 
heard from the head priest and Grass-san, 
there's no precedent for it, but it 
shouldn't be against the rules.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! This is heavy, so if I go back 
too, it'll just waste energy... That's 
why,

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want you to head back alone to relight 
the fire, Dia-chan. 
In the meantime, I'll push ahead as far as 
I can...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Okay, got it. I think that's a great plan. 
As long as I have the light, I can speed 
up and catch up to you in no time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Once we regroup, if the two of us run at 
full speed, we can make up for lost time. 
And then...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We'll make it in time for the first 
sunrise...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(—Let's go! I have to move forward, even 
just a little bit. 
That's what I need to do right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dia-chan is running with all her might 
too...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I must go. Kita-chan is running, 
believing in me...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The darkness, failure—none of it is 
scary. Because we...!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
(Even if our paths are separate, we're 
running together—!)
